senses.gloss:
भेतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be feared or apprehended.
 E. भी to fear,
तव्य aff.

भेत्तृ mfn. (-त्ता-त्त्री-त्तृ) Who or what divides, disunites, &c.
 m. (-त्ता)
1. A divider or separator.
 2. A factious or seditious man, a traitor,
or one who secretly corresponds with an enemy, &c.
 E. भिद् to di-
vide, to sow dissension, aff. तृच् ।
